resources.string: Maps Bluetooth controller buttons to on-screen taps and swipes
PulsePad uses this service to read Bluetooth controller input and replay it as on-screen gestures. It does not read your screen content and never sends data off the device.
PulsePad adapts to what this device allows. Nothing here is fatal — each result changes how the app behaves.
Not enabled — mapping works only inside PulsePad.
Available — the 3D controller studio can render.
Unavailable — the studio falls back to a 2D schematic.
Available — PulsePad can connect controllers directly.
Unavailable — PulsePad lists bonded controllers and detects their input instead.
Not present — PulsePad needs no Google services, so this changes nothing.
This Android version is not supported
PulsePad requires Android 9 (API 28) or newer. This device runs an older version, so the app cannot read controller input here.
